metadata.name: GLC-SHARE
metadata.fullName: FAO Global Land Cover SHARE Beta-Release 1.0 - 2014
metadata.author: John Latham, Renato Cumani, Ilaria Rosati, Mario Bloise
metadata.organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
metadata.description: Global land cover database at 1km resolution with 11 aggregated land cover classes based on LCCS and SEEA legend systems, combining best available national, regional and sub-national databases
